assertion.statement: The fixed standard integer substitutions in the degree-s symbols of Section13 preserve every actual tensor equivalence and its lower-degree error.
assertion.objects: The T-symbol expressions on the full limit lattice and their fixed integer forms.
assertion.hypotheses: The multilinear representative and all compared tensor expressions are actually represented as stipulated; ordinary total-degree s is used for symbol arithmetic.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such fixed T and every such represented nilcharacter and equivalence.
assertion.parameter_range: Fixed finite dimensions and ordinary degree bound d.
assertion.uniformity: The same target geometry and test are retained; only the polynomial orbit is precomposed.
assertion.constants: No new test Lipschitz constant or target dimension is required.
assertion.normalizations: Restrictions to boxes occur only after the full-lattice identity or after the stated domain-specific argument; no extrapolation from an orthant.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Zero maps and rank-deficient maps may lower the actual degree. No arbitrary linear map is asserted to preserve a multidegree rectangle.
assertion.limit_order: Check the source and target degree filtrations, then precompose the orbit and its lower-degree comparison.

use.reason: The fixed substitutions preserve ordinary degree by direct iterated differences and pull back the same lower-degree tensor test. Multilinearity, reflection recovery and factorial torsion remain separately supplied.

supplier.statement: Precomposition of a degree-at-most d nilcharacter by a fixed integer linear map is again a degree-at-most d nilcharacter. The same precomposition preserves degree-d symbol equivalence.

publication.title: An inverse theorem for the Gowers U^{s+1}[N]-norm
publication.authors: Ben Green, Terence Tao and Tamar Ziegler
publication.locator: Lemma E.8(vi), p.1354, with proof reference p.1356
publication.corrections: The printed E8(vi) contains a domain mismatch for chi-prime, and its B5 citation has a composition codomain typo. The current fixed-integer-map application is checked directly: each iterated difference after precomposition equals the original iterated difference in the image directions. The unchanged global test retains its vertical identity; a lower-degree representation pulls back the same way. No unchecked multidegree or arbitrary limit-coefficient claim is used.
